page_title: NAN 0-1 STR | Nantes v Strasbourg 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+8' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
90+5' The referee signals a substitution. Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) is brought on as a substitute for Emanuel Emegha.

90+4' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the top left corner. His effort is blocked by Djordje Petrovic with a brilliant diving save!
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) loses his marker in the box from the resulting corner, times his jump well but flashes his close-range header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
90' Nantes force their opponents to concede a corner.
90' Sebastian Nanasi will be replaced by Daouda Diongue (Strasbourg).
88' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nantes.
86' Substitution. Dilane Bakwa leaves the pitch and is replaced by Eduard Sobol (Strasbourg).
83' Antoine Kombouare has decided to make a change. Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) replaces Sorba Thomas.
83' A substitution has been made. Johann Lepenant is replaced by Meschack Elia (Nantes).

81' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header, but sent the ball into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
81' Free kick. Nantes will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
80' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Guela Doue (Strasbourg) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Nantes.

79' 0 - 1 Dilane Bakwa sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 0:1.

77' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and rose high to reach a fine corner kick. He fails to direct the ball past the goalkeeper as it flies narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
76' The ball is out of play. Strasbourg will have a chance to score from a corner.
71' Antoine Kombouare has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Moses Simon (Nantes) replacing Mostafa Mohamed.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) replaces Marcus Coco.
70' Marcus Coco (Nantes) jumps into a tackle and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem signals a foul. Strasbourg have a free kick.
68' The resulting set piece from Strasbourg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
66' The linesman raises his flag. Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is adjudged offside.
65' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
63' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
63' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
62' Strasbourg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.

60' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
57' Antoine Kombouare is forced to make a change. Douglas Augusto is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Pedro Chirivella (Nantes).
56' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
52' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) was too forceful with his tackle and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Nantes win a free kick.
51' The goal by Strasbourg won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
51' Wait! Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has indicated he is going to review the Strasbourg goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
49' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the left post.
48' Strasbourg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
46' Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
40' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
36' Marcus Coco (Nantes) tackles a bit over-zealously and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows for a foul. Strasbourg have a free kick.
34' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. A free kick to Strasbourg.
33' Strasbourg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
31' Strasbourg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

31' A pass lands at the feet of Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
29' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) takes a short corner kick.

25' A precise low pass is received by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
25' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Nantes.
22' The free kick from long range, taken by Nantes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

21' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for an infringement. Nantes earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
20' Strasbourg take a short corner kick.
20' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg win a corner kick.
18' Louis Leroux (Nantes) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Louis Leroux (Nantes) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
17' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Nantes get a free kick.
16' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes). Strasbourg will take a free kick near the side line.
14' That's unlucky! Matthis Abline (Nantes) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
14' Nantes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
10' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle after Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Nantes have been awarded a free kick.
7' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) has tested the patience of referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
4' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
3' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Nantes, play can continue.

2' There's a break in play and referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Nantes using VAR. This could be interesting!
2' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Nantes will take the kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
